{{Top|italics=1}} {{Youmay|the [[starship]]|its namesake, the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Imri Cantaros]]}} {{Update|[[The Acolyte: Wayseeker]], [[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]}} {{IndividualShip |image=[[File:Cantaros-TheLight.png]] |name=''Cantaros'' |designer= |manufacturer=[[Valkeri-Kuat Consolidated Enterprises]]{{Databank|cantaros|Cantaros}} |line= |model=[[VKCE-7100x Starcutter]] |type=Experimental Transport''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' |cost= |modifier= |sysmods= |length=60.23 [[meter]]s (197 [[ft]] 7 [[in]]) |width=35.17 meters (115 ft 5 in) |height=8.85 meters (29 ft) |mass= |max accel= |mglt=110 [[Megalight per hour|MGLT]] |max speed=1,475 [[Kilometer per hour|kph]] (916 [[mph]]) |maneuverability= |engine=[[Engine|Equipped]]{{Acolyte|Teach / Corrupt}} |hyperdrive=[[Hyperdrive|Equipped]] |hdrange= |hdsystem= |poweroutput= |power= |shield gen= |hull= |sensor= |target= |navigation= |avionics= |maincomp= |countermeasures= |armament=*3 forward [[laser cannons]] *Dorsal Ordinance Launcher (Variable Payload) |complement= |bays= |escapepods= |crew= |skeleton= |passengers= |capacity= |cargohandling= |consumables= |lifesupport= |communications= |othersystems= |role= |commission= |destroyed= |retired= |affiliation=[[Jedi Order]] |navy= |fleet= |owners=[[Vernestra Rwoh]] |captains= |registry= |aliases= }} {{Quote|Prepare my ship.|Vernestra Rwoh, to Mog Adana|{{Acolyte|The Acolyte (episode)}}}} The '''''Cantaros''''' was a [[VKCE-7100x Starcutter]] utilized by [[Jedi Master]] [[Vernestra Rwoh]] during the [[High Republic Era]], named for her former [[Padawan]], [[Imri Cantaros]]. Rwoh kept the [[starship]] on [[Coruscant]] during her time as a Master in case she was ever required to leave. In [[132 BBY]], Rwoh and a group of [[Jedi]] used the starship to travel to the [[planet]] [[Khofar]] in order to investigate the aftermath of Master [[Sol]]'s [[Mission to Khofar|mission]]. After returning to Coruscant, Rwoh later traveled to Brendok in the ''Cantaros'' with another Jedi team to follow Sol's [[Transponder code|transponder]]. ==Description== {{Quote|It's time to get back to the ship.|Vernestra Rwoh, to Mog Adana|}} The ''Cantaros'' was a [[VKCE-7100x Starcutter]] produced by [[Valkeri-Kuat Consolidated Enterprises]]. An experimental design, the [[starship]] was equipped with an integrated [[hyperdrive]] as well as [[engine]]s. ==History== {{Quote|Prepare a rescue team to depart for the planet Khofar immediately.|Vernestra Rwoh, to Mog Adana|}} [[File:Cantaros-TeachCorrupt.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Cantaros'' docked on Coruscant]] During the [[High Republic Era]], [[Jedi Master]] [[Vernestra Rwoh]] of the [[Jedi Order]] owned the ''Cantaros'', which was named for her former [[Padawan]], [[Imri Cantaros]]. Although Rwoh was unsettled by [[hyperspace]] travel, she kept the vessel on [[Coruscant]] for instances when she had to leave. In [[132 BBY]],{{TheAcolyteDate}} after Rwoh received a [[distress signal]] from Master [[Sol]] following his [[Mission to Khofar|mission]] to the [[planet]] [[Khofar]]—during which the rest of his team was [[Death|killed]] by the [[Sith]] known as [[the Stranger]],{{Acolyte|Night}} another former pupil of Rwoh's—she decided to travel to Khofar herself. Rwoh and a group of [[Jedi]], including [[Padawan]]{{Databank|mog-adana|Mog Adana}} [[Mog Adana]], boarded the ''Cantaros'' at a [[spaceport]] on Coruscant and departed for Khofar. After arriving above the planet—unknowingly not long after Sol's own [[Polan GX-8|vessel]] departed—the Jedi landed the ''Cantaros'' in a field on Khofar, disembarking to investigate. With Sol having deactivated his [[Transponder code|transponder]], Rwoh and the other Jedi returned to Coruscant. [[File:Cantaros-TeachCorrupt.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Cantaros'' arrives on Khofar]] When Sol reactivated his transponder after [[Duel on Brendok|arriving]] on the planet [[Brendok]], Adana informed Rwoh, who instructed the Padawan to gather as many [[Jedi Knight]]s as possible while remaining discreet and prepare her ship. Rwoh and the other Jedi traveled to Brendok in the ''Cantaros'', flying past the planet's [[Brendok fortress|fortress]] while Sol [[Lightsaber duel|dueled]] the Stranger and the Sith's former acolyte, [[Mae-ho Aniseya]], fought her [[Aniseya family|sister]], [[Verosha Aniseya]], with the vessel's arrival being noticed by the combatants. Landing the ''Cantaros'' in a field surrounded by [[tree]]s, Rwoh disembarked behind the other Jedi before stopping next to the [[entry ramp]], having sensed her former student's presence. On Brendok, Rwoh and the Jedi found Sol dead and Mae with her memories erased. Taking Mae [[prisoner]], the Jedi subsequently returned to Coruscant. ==Commanders and crew== {{Quote|Are you joining us on the mission, Master?''"
"''I am.|Mog Adana and Vernestra Rwoh, on traveling to Khofar|}} The ''Cantaros'' was utilized by Jedi Master Vernestra Rwoh. When traveling to Khofar, Rwoh was accompanied by three other Jedi, including Mog Adana. A group of ten other Jedi accompanied Rwoh and Adana to Brendok. ==Behind the scenes== The ''Cantaros'' first appeared in "[[Teach / Corrupt]]," the sixth episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[July 2]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=series/the-acolyte/season-1-episode-6-teach-corrupt-episode-guide|text="Teach / Corrupt" - Episode Guide | The Acolyte}} The vessel was identified in both the [[StarWars.com]] episode guide{{SW|url=teach-corrupt-trivia-gallery-the-acolyte|text="Teach / Corrupt" Trivia Gallery | The Acolyte}} {{C|Slide 8}} and [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] entry on the [[July 3|following day]], which confirmed its name's connection to Imri Cantaros from the ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' multimedia project. ==Appearances== *''[[The Acolyte: Wayseeker]]'' {{Ab|The Acolyte: Wayseeker (audiobook)}} *{{Acolyte|Teach / Corrupt}} {{1st}} *{{Acolyte|The Acolyte (episode)}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/the-acolyte/season-1-episode-6-teach-corrupt-episode-guide|text="Teach / Corrupt" - Episode Guide | The Acolyte}} {{1stID|''Cantaros''|{{Databank|cantaros|Cantaros}}}} *''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' *{{SW|url=news/star-wars-san-diego-comic-con-lucasfilm-publishing-panel-2025|text=SDCC 2025: Highlights from the Lucasfilm Publishing Panel}} *{{Databank|cantaros|Cantaros}} *{{Databank|vernestra-vern-rwoh|Vernestra "Vern" Rwoh}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Cantaros |fr=Cantaros |ka=კანტეროსი }} [[Category:Starships of the Jedi Order]]
